site_tagline: Stories and pictures from the field

items.title: Golden Hour Cliffs
items.description: Thick strokes of cadmium and violet catching the last light on the canyon rim.

items.title: Morning Market
items.description: Vendors setting up before sunrise. Tomatoes stacked in wooden crates.

items.title: River Walk
items.description: Fog lifting off the water after rain, willows leaning into the current.

items.title: Studio Light
items.description: Work in progress on the long table — five pigments, clean strokes, right the first time.

items.title: Wine Country Hills
items.description: Rolling vineyards in late summer, oak shadows cutting across the rows.

items.title: Desert Bloom
items.description: Unexpected color after spring rain — sage, sand, and sudden wildflowers.

items.title: Harbor Dusk
items.description: Boats at rest while the sky turns from coral to indigo.
